metrics.label: Revenue growth
metrics.reading: Revenue compounded 16% a year over 5 years, 7% over 3 (slowing); last 12 months 20%.

metrics.label: Profit growth
metrics.reading: Profit compounded 35% a year over 5 years, 19% over 3; last 12 months 20%.

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.reading: Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 150% of net profit (strong).

metrics.label: Debt
metrics.reading: Borrowings ₹99,165 cr, 0.73× equity; up from ₹64,486 cr in FY22.

bull.point: Q1FY26 copper EBITDA reached INR 673 crores, beating the guided target of ₹600 cr.
Novelis exit savings run rate reached $200M in FY26, exceeding the target of $150M.
Consolidated net debt-to-EBITDA stood at 1.95x, meeting management's target to stay below 2x.

bear.point: Renewable capacity expansion missed its target, delivering 470 megawatts against the 523 megawatts guidance in Q1FY27.
Management repeatedly deferred the Bay Minette project completion target, pushing execution from Q3FY26 to Q4FY27.
Operating margin compressed from 15% in FY22 to 13% in FY26 as total borrowings rose to ₹99,165 cr.
